items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: My mother was playing with Elbert Topps, this is why I went with Elbert Topps. And Dan Grissom was playing saxophone.

ctx.x: Albert Topps, then Jimmie Bell, and then back to Elbert Topps. (inaudible)
Hey, Elbert Topps. My mother was playing with Elbert Topps, this is why I went with Elbert Topps. And Dan Grissom was playing saxophone. We played -- yeah, Dan Grissom was playing saxophone.
